A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Sakiyan''' worked as the [[Bouncer (occupation)/Legends|bouncer]] at [[Quarek'k]], a seedy [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] in the [[Undercity (Taris)|underlevels]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. He let the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] into the establishment when she bribed him with one hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
